text:
alana: Heads up — seeing duplicate page fetches in the onboarding sample app when the Python SDK is hit with a small burst. Go SDK doesn't reproduce.

alana: Repro (local): run sampleapp-with-prefetch against local staging token, fire ~40 concurrent pagination requests. After a couple token refreshes we start getting the same next_page_token processed twice.

alana: Logs (trimmed):
```
INFO fetch_page page=2 inflight=7
ERROR token_refresh failed, retrying
INFO fetch_page page=2 inflight=8
INFO fetch_page page=2 inflight=8  # duplicate work observed
```

mohit: can you confirm whether the inflight permit counter is owned by the paginator or the request layer? :eyes:

alana: it's the client-side inflight semaphore in client/prefetch/windowing.py. Suspect path: token refresh throws, retry path re-enqueues without releasing permit. I can repro with a minimal script.

jen: which python sdk version? any custom backpressure config?

alana: py-sdk 0.8.2, using default permits=16, prefetch=2. Go team is on 0.8.3 and we couldn't repro there.

samir: CI bot flagged something similar last week — @ci-bot can you paste the flaky test link?

ci-bot: https://ci.redwood/example/test-suite/flake-231 — flaky.test: test_pagination_race (investigate token refresh interleaving).

mohit: quick hypothesis: token refresh/401 retry path isn't running finally/release semantics in the Python backoff wrapper. If a retry loop raises and we requeue the work, we might be double-counting inflight.

alana: here's the minimal diff that fixed it locally (pseudo):
```py
# before
try:
    do_request()
except AuthError:
    retry_request()
# missing release on early return

# after
acquire_permit()
try:
    do_request()
except AuthError:
    retry_request()
finally:
    release_permit()
```

jen: that aligns with what I'd expect. Can you open a small PR with unit + integration that simulates concurrent token refresh + pagination? Add an assert that inflight counter returns to 0 after work drains.

alana: will do. I'll also add an optional instrumentation metric: inflight_leaks counter to catch regresses.

mohit: once you have the PR, ping me — we should also backport to 0.8.2 patch branch (customers onboarding using that).

samir: should we add a compatibility note in the sampleapp README about SDK parity on token handling? Might save a few support tickets.

alana: good call — adding a short note and a troubleshooting snippet for "duplicate page results" and the token-refresh workaround.

jen: nice triage. :thumbsup: Please include the failing log snippet in the PR description so QA can add an e2e.

alana: will do. Opening PR in ~30m. Thanks all. :pray:
